title: Mayday call in Saginaw Bay, Michigan
description: A Coast Guard Station Saginaw River response boat crew rescued three people and one dog from the water in Saginaw Bay, Michigan, Nov. 23, 2019. The operator issued a Mayday call over the radio before the vessel capsized and sank. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Lauren Steenson.
pass_reason: text cards over calm water b-roll; rescue not filmed
